confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors cross-check against Numbeo's November 2026 Palermo page (user-submitted) and several cost-of-living guides, though some inputs date from 2023-2024. Cocktail (about 1.9x beer) and wine by the glass (about 1.1x beer) are the weakest food anchors because no direct Palermo restaurant benchmark was found for either; they are sense-checked against Kalsa bar price ranges. Beer assumes a 0.5 L draught, and euro figures use an approximate 1.13 USD per EUR, not a live rate. Accommodation anchors are model estimates for July peak season, with no accommodation searches or live listings checked, so they are the least certain. The FX value comes from a search summary of the RBA page, not a direct page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used for food or drink. Those anchors follow Palermo-specific figures from Numbeo and cost-of-living guides, and one index places Palermo below the Italian average. Accommodation is a holistic model estimate by analogy with other mid-sized southern Italian cities at July peak demand, not checked against live listings.
